_what: Ticked success criteria naming a camelCase symbol OR a file artifact that occurs nowhere in this tree's executable source, structured data or filesystem (#1161, widened to filenames by #1217). One row per (spec, criterion, symbol). Owned by lib/ticked-sc-symbols.ts, refused in BOTH directions by test/ticked-sc-absent-symbol.test.ts: a new row fails the suite, and a row that stopped being a violation fails it too, so a cleared entry has to be deleted in the same commit that clears it.
_howToClear: Build the thing the criterion names, or untick the criterion, or — if the criterion is right and the detector is wrong — say so in the reason and leave the row. A row with no reason, or a reason under 80 characters, is refused.
_notACoverageList: This is not a list of exemptions from testing. Every row below is a ticked claim nothing in the tree supports, except where the reason says the detector misread prose. Rows removed when the criterion is fixed, never when it becomes inconvenient.
_clearedBy1217: Five rows left this file in #1217 and the criteria are the reason, not the tidying: SC-135 (proofOfFix) and SC-237 (canaryResults, directHitRate, fileLoadRate, toolCallCount) are now unticked, so they are no longer violations and the equality refuses them being kept. SC-108 (quinn-journey.yaml) was unticked in the same change and never reached this file at all — the camelCase sweep is structurally blind to a kebab-case filename, and the artifact half added by #1217 is what found it. It is the same defect as SC-135: the other of the two workflow-state fields #317 recorded as declared and touched by nothing.

rows.HARNESS-STANDARD.md::SC-678::xRan: DETECTOR FALSE POSITIVE. `xRan` is a metavariable inside a quoted code sample — the criterion reads "every `let xResult = { result: 'PASS' }` in ship.js must be paired with an observed `let xRan = false`", where x stands for a phase name. No symbol is being claimed. Widening the pattern to exclude multi-token code spans was considered and rejected: it would also stop catching `runBehavioralCompliance(root)` written inside a span, which is the shape the original defect took at INSTRUCTION-COMPLIANCE-SPEC.md:86.
rows.HARNESS-STANDARD.md::SC-678::xResult: DETECTOR FALSE POSITIVE, same criterion and same cause as the `xRan` row above — a metavariable in a quoted code sample, not a symbol reference. Kept as two rows rather than one because the ratchet's unit is the symbol, and collapsing them would hide one of the two if the criterion were reworded to drop only one metavariable.
